definitions.explanation: The bones of the head that enclose the brain. The everyday word is ずがいこつ; doctors also say とうがいこつ.

examples.japanese: {頭蓋骨|ずがいこつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{化石|かせき}→化石：11796_kaseki⟧。
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{頭蓋骨|ずがいこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He fractured his skull in the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{古代人|こだいじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頭蓋骨|ずがいこつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}べて→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Ancient human skulls were displayed side by side in the museum.

notes:
{頭|ず} (head) + {蓋|がい} (lid) + {骨|こつ} (bone).

PRONUNCIATION:
- ずがいこつ: the usual reading in everyday language and school biology
- とうがいこつ: the reading many doctors and anatomy texts prefer; {頭蓋|とうがい}⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ (intracranial) is read this way too

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{骸骨|がいこつ}→骸骨：18307_gaikotsu⟧: skeleton; also a skull as a spooky image (Halloween, pirates)
- ⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧: bone, the everyday word
